claim_boundary: one Windows/WSL2 physical node, one RTX 4080, one Triton GPU container, one local PostgreSQL control-plane instance, controlled traffic; no production SLA, physical HA, database HA/DR, multi-node, multi-GPU, MIG, MPS, or physical zero-interruption guarantee

required_sequence: canonical baseline 3 plus success 3x1000 plus five fault classes x3

switch_fence_contract.actor_receipt_gate: exact four prefix bridge IDs times three actor stages, committed and independently readback-visible before switch
switch_fence_contract.crossover_gate: exact causal hold plus designated prefix bridge singleton remain pending on old Blue generation
switch_fence_contract.online_terminal_gate: each exact39 response must match the scheduled request, attempt, run, Blue model role/name/version/artifact, old generation, terminal 200 outcome, and durable readback
switch_fence_contract.postgresql_terminal_fence: the switch transaction locks and reprojects exact39 PostgreSQL terminal entities, idempotency rows, and durable terminal-effect events; it binds the canonical ID set, record hash, and causal sequences before appending the switch fence
switch_fence_contract.raw_evidence: pre-switch terminal entity and causal-event exports plus exact online response records are retained and independently reprojected
switch_fence_contract.release: only after switch commit, independent readback, and route-applied acknowledgement; exact pending crossover set only
switch_fence_contract.timeout: one frozen route_switch_barrier_timeout_seconds value is used for schedule capacity, receipt, exact39 terminal, switch, and final crossover completion gates

focused_and_real_postgresql.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_s6bm_experiment_runner.py tests/test_s6bm_runtime.py tests/test_transactional_control_plane.py tests/test_triton_blue_green.py
